description: WP-S4 Space Wolves STORM SHIELD and BLIZZARD SHIELD (wargear) on the table. Fixture sw11e_s4_shields (P1 Space Wolves' Command phase, round 2), built from armies/sw11e_codex_test.json through ArmyListManager: the Wolf Guard Terminators that took 4 Storm Shields (+1 W) — 4 tokens draw a 4-wound health bar, 6 a 3-wound bar, and wound allocation sees a separate 4-W group; the Thunderwolf Cavalry with 2 Storm Shields (4+ invulnerable save on those 2 models); the Venerable Dreadnought with a Blizzard Shield (4+ invulnerable save).

steps.comment: a window not under test (if any) is declined

steps.script:
var m = tree.root.get_node("Main")
var focus := Vector2(880.000000, 1760.000000)
var z := 1.500000
var vp: Vector2 = m.get_viewport().get_visible_rect().size
m.camera.position = focus
m.camera.zoom = Vector2(z, z)
m.view_zoom = z
m.view_offset = focus - vp / (2.0 * z)
m.update_view_transform()
return true
steps.comment: frame the Terminators, Thunderwolves and the Venerable Dreadnought
Storm Shield (+1 W): 4 Terminator tokens draw a 4-wound health bar, the other 6 a 3-wound bar
wound allocation sees two groups: 6 models with 3 W and the 4 shield bearers with 4 W
Storm Shield (Thunderwolf Cavalry): the 2 shield bearers have a 4+ invulnerable save
Blizzard Shield: the Venerable Dreadnought has a 4+ invulnerable save
clean debug log: no ERROR line was written during the scenario
